messages.author: 146bc26797d1c5e2
messages.subject: Variable name 'T' in Stan data
parts:
I have a model file that starts with 

data {
  int<lower=1> T; int<lower=1> D;
  real xobs[T]; real yobs[T]; real crot[T]; real srot[T];
}
parameters {
  real x[T]; real y[T];
  real<lower=0> sigma;
  real<lower=0> asigma;

Stan 1.3 compiles this without problems, but 2.1.0 gives a bunch of error messages.

I replaced 'T' with 'N', and the model compiles fine (at least with respect to this problem).

The error messages are

Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! file752f513ff0e6.cpp: In member function ‘T model752f7a0e8cd4_acc2_namespace::model752f7a0e8cd4_acc2::log_prob(Eigen::Matrix<T_cut, -0x00000000000000001, 1, 0, -0x00000000000000001, 1>&, std::ostream*) const’:
file752f513ff0e6.cpp:436: error: ‘model752f7a0e8cd4_acc2_namespace::model752f7a0e8cd4_acc2::T’ cannot appear in a constant-expression
file752f513ff0e6.cpp:436: error: template argument 1 is invalid
file752f513ff0e6.cpp:436: error: template argument 2 is invalid
file752f513ff0e6.cpp:436: error: invalid type in declaration before ‘;’ token
file752f513ff0e6.cpp:437: error: request for member ‘reserve’ in ‘vec_params_r’, which is of non-class type ‘int’
file752f513ff0e6.cpp:439: error: request for member ‘push_back’ in ‘vec_params_r’, which is of non-class type ‘int’
file752f513ff0e6.cpp:441: error: ‘model752f7a0e8cd4_acc2_namespace::model752f7a0e8cd4_acc2::T’ cannot appear in a co
In addition: Warning message:
running command '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin/R CMD SHLIB file752f513ff0e6.cpp 2> file752f513ff0e6.cpp.err.txt' had status 1 

and the corresponding C++ lines:

431:     } // log_prob()
432: 
433:     template <bool propto, bool jacobian, typename T>
434:     T log_prob(Eigen::Matrix<T,Eigen::Dynamic,1>& params_r,
435:                std::ostream* pstream = 0) const {
436:       std::vector<T> vec_params_r;
437:       vec_params_r.reserve(params_r.size());
438:       for (int i = 0; i < params_r.size(); ++i)
439:         vec_params_r.push_back(params_r(i));
440:       std::vector<int> vec_params_i;
441:       return log_prob<propto,jacobian,T>(vec_params_r, vec_params_i, pstream);
442:     }
